$notes: Vault-local Solana program schemas, merged OVER @pioneer-platform/pioneer-discovery at load time (see solana-instruction-decoder.ts). Adding a program here makes the clear-signing review UI decode it immediately, without waiting on a pioneer-discovery release. Entries here should also be contributed upstream to pioneer-discovery/src/solana-programs.json so other clients get them; once a published version carries the program, the entry can be dropped from this file. Same shape as the upstream registry.

99vQwtBwYtrqqD9YSXbdum3KBdxPAVxYTaQ3cfnJ.name: Relay Bridge
99vQwtBwYtrqqD9YSXbdum3KBdxPAVxYTaQ3cfnJ.description: Relay cross-chain bridge. Deposits the origin asset into a Relay vault; the matching payout on the destination chain is Relay's off-chain obligation and is NOT verifiable from this instruction. Layout confirmed against live api.relay.link quotes 2026-07-27: the u64 amount tracked the requested input exactly across 0.5 / 0.123456789 / 0.999 SOL.

0d9e0ddf5fd51c06.name: depositNative
0d9e0ddf5fd51c06.description: Deposit native SOL to a Relay vault for a cross-chain fill.

Stake11111111111111111111111111111111111.name: Stake Program
Stake11111111111111111111111111111111111.description: Native staking: delegate, deactivate, split, merge, withdraw. Only DelegateStake and Deactivate are decoded here: they keep the stake account's authorities, and firmware shows both. Authorize, Split and Withdraw can hand control or funds to another account and stay undecoded.

02000000.name: delegateStake
02000000.description: Delegate a stake account to a validator's vote account.

05000000.name: deactivate
05000000.description: Deactivate a stake account so it can be withdrawn after cooldown.

ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA.description: Derives and creates the canonical token account for (wallet, mint) pairs. Same as pioneer-discovery plus the "" entry: Create was first sent with empty data, which has no u8 discriminator, and firmware shows it as Create.
